name: XlChartPictureType
description: Specifies how pictures are displayed on a column, bar picture chart, or legend key.

constants.name: xlStackScale
constants.description: The picture is sized to a specified number of units and repeated the length of the bar.

constants.name: xlStack
constants.description: The picture is sized to repeat a maximum of 15 times in the longest stacked bar.

constants.name: xlStretch
constants.description: The picture is stretched the full length of the stacked bar.
